hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash -e
echo "===== Verify Artifacts =====" echo "List $WORKSPACE/artifacts" ls -lh "$WORKSPACE/artifacts"
test -x "$WORKSPACE/artifacts/finance_cluster" test -f "$WORKSPACE/artifacts/libmsg_dumper.so" test -f "$WORKSPACE/artifacts/libpg_db_access.so"
echo "Artifact verification passed!"

#!/bin/bash -e # For Debug #set -eux #set -eu
#echo "Docker integration test temporarily disabled" #exit 0
CLUSTER_NETWORK_NAME=finance_cluster_network #1 整數 1 #${1} Shell Script 的第一個位置參數 #${4} Shell Script 的第四個位置參數 #${NODE_COUNT} 變數 NODE_COUNT 的值 NODE_COUNT_MIN=1 NODE_COUNT_MAX=4 if [[ ${NODE_COUNT} -lt ${NODE_COUNT_MIN} || ${NODE_COUNT} -gt ${NODE_COUNT_MAX} ]] then echo "The Node Count(${NODE_COUNT}) is out of range: [${NODE_COUNT_MIN}, ${NODE_COUNT_MAX}]" fi for ((i=1; i<=NODE_COUNT_MAX; i++)) do NODE_NAME=${CONTAINER_NAME}${i} docker container rm -f ${NODE_NAME} 2> /dev/null || true done docker network rm "${CLUSTER_NETWORK_NAME}" 2>/dev/null || true
LOCAL=Asia/Taipei DOCKER_COMMAND_BASE=" -e TZ=${LOCAL} --rm -dit --network ${CLUSTER_NETWORK_NAME}" # 加上雙引號 " 可以避免空字串導致語法錯誤 if [ "${ENABLE_COREDUMP}" = "true" ] then DOCKER_COMMAND_BASE="${DOCKER_COMMAND_BASE} --privileged" fi if [ "${NEED_DATABASE_NETWORK}" = "true" ] then DOCKER_COMMAND_BASE="${DOCKER_COMMAND_BASE} --network ${DATABASE_NETWORK_NAME}" fi
docker network create "${CLUSTER_NETWORK_NAME}" SERVER_NAME="" for ((i=1; i<=NODE_COUNT; i++)) do NODE_NAME=${CONTAINER_NAME}${i} DOCKER_COMMAND="${DOCKER_COMMAND_BASE} --name ${NODE_NAME}" NODE_PORT=$((HOST_PORT+i-1)) if [ "${ENABLE_PORT}" = "true" ] then DOCKER_COMMAND="${DOCKER_COMMAND} -p ${NODE_PORT}:${CONTAINER_PORT}" fi docker container rm -f ${NODE_NAME} 2> /dev/null || true docker container run ${DOCKER_COMMAND} ${LINUXC_IMAGE_NAME} bash if [ "${ENABLE_COREDUMP}" = "true" ] then docker container exec -u root -i ${NODE_NAME} bash -c "mkdir /var/coredump && chmod a+rw /var/coredump && echo '/var/coredump/core_%e.%p_%t' > /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern" fi # 這會把 Jenkins Workspace 裡的執行檔、.so 和設定檔複製到指定 container 的 /app/bin docker cp "$WORKSPACE/artifacts/." "${NODE_NAME}:/app/bin/" docker container exec -u root "${NODE_NAME}" bash -c "mkdir -p /app/bin/log && chown -R super:super /app/bin && chmod 755 /app/bin/log" if [ ${i} = 1 ] then SERVER_NAME=${NODE_NAME} docker container exec -u super -i ${NODE_NAME} bash -c "cd /app/bin && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=./ && ./finance_cluster" else docker container exec -d -u super -i ${NODE_NAME} bash -c "cd /app/bin && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=./ && ./finance_cluster -j ${SERVER_NAME}" fi done
